query:
update tree_node set folder = $4 || substr(folder, length($3) + 1)
            where connection_id = $1
                and (folder = $3 or substr(folder, 1, length($3) + 1) = $3 || '/')
                and case when $2 = '' then path <> '' and instr(path, '/') = 0
                    else substr(path, 1, length($2) + 1) = $2 || '/' end
